# Docs

- [Why Zellij Agent Threads](/why): Why Zellij Agent Threads exists, and what problem it solves.
- [Quickstart](/quickstart): Install the released CLI, add the Zellij plugin pane, and see Pi Agents in Zellij.
- [How it works](/how-it-works): How the Pi wrapper runs the agent-threads CLI, and how the Zellij plugin reads snapshots.
- [Generic harness setup](/harness-setup): Connect any agent harness that can run hook commands to Zellij Agent Threads.
- [Templates](/templates): Template configuration, model fields, actions, and color values.
- [Troubleshooting](/troubleshooting): Fix common install, panel, store, and template problems.
